content: To assess the effectiveness of bi-directional attention, we bypassed the bi-attention layer by directly feeding the contextual hidden states and query embeddings to the modeling layer. To evaluate the pre-trained GloVe embeddings, we randomly initialized and trained the embeddings from scratch. These two procedures lead to 10% and 18% performance degradation on the Augmented Set and Real-World Set, respectively (see Table TABREF27 ).
